spiritual_reading.full_translation:
When the good that engages directly with evil advanced to meet the assault, it invested itself with the outward truth that carries the full force of love, and by that invested state it dried up and subdued the swelling self-exaltation of what opposed it, bringing down the enemy’s empty persuasion and vainglorious pretension.

That single invested power was sufficient for those who depended on it; yet because the primary force of love in outward action had been weakened through conflict, it therefore added a full support by surrounding that love with additional exterior forms of operation: one that gave it active impulsion, one that gave it ordered discernment through truth, one that gave it clear intelligence, and one that gave it a stable ultimate plane for action. These were given so that they might serve as helpers to the governing love, so that what is hostile could not enter that love in its outward working and pierce it, and so that destructive falsity and enmity could not sever its connection.

Although love in its external operation suffered assault and felt injury in its embodied form, still by means of that state the whole array of falsities was constrained. And because the combat required conjunction and cooperation, it was also necessary that the supporting powers as companions in that work should undergo assault and injury as well, for the enemy’s influence entered and mingled with them—except for the ultimate plane of action itself. Into that ultimate plane active falsity did not mingle, and the heated rage of the enemy was not able to pass into it.

Nevertheless even the supporting power that remained without injury—the ultimate plane of action—divested itself of its own external investment and operative strength and transferred it to its four companions, so that by means of that enlivened ultimate support they might be made firm, become effective for use, and endure in their functions. And that ultimate support became for them a continuing vitality in their labor.

paragraph_translations.translation: When the good that engages directly with evil advanced to meet the assault, it invested itself with the outward truth that carries the full force of love. By that invested state it dried up and subdued the swelling self-exaltation of the opposing force, and it brought down the enemy’s empty persuasion and vainglorious pretension.
paragraph_translations.connection: OPENS the spiritual action by showing direct combat and the first victorious investment.
paragraph_translations.notes: The word rendered as “tumescence” is uncertain; taken as swelling pride or inflated selfhood to preserve the spiritual motion.

paragraph_translations.translation: That single invested power was sufficient for those who depended on it; yet because love in its outward operation had been weakened by the conflict, it added a complete support by surrounding it with four further exterior forms of operation: an active impulsion, an ordering by truth, a clarity of intelligence, and a stable ultimate plane for action. These were given to assist the governing love, so that what is hostile could not enter into that love in its outward working and pierce it, and so that destructive falsity and enmity could not cut off its conjunction.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS by adding supporting powers to protect the primary love in externals.
paragraph_translations.notes: The four added forms are forced into a consistent series of functions; “air” is taken as the stable ultimate plane because the next paragraphs treat it as unmixable and remaining behind.

paragraph_translations.translation: Although love in its external operation received assault and felt injury in its embodied form, still through that state the whole array of falsities was constrained. And because the work demanded companionship and coordinated conjunction, it was necessary that the five supporting powers should receive assault and injury as well. The enemy’s influence entered and mingled with them—except for the ultimate plane of action: into that plane falsity did not mingle, and the heated rage of the enemy was not able to penetrate it.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES by describing the wounding of the operative forms and the exception that preserves an ultimate.
paragraph_translations.notes: The paragraph’s syntax is fractured in the source; the sense of “necessity for the five to be companions/brothers” is maintained as required conjunction in combat.

paragraph_translations.translation: Nevertheless even the supporting power that remained without injury—the ultimate plane of action—divested itself of its own external investment and operative strength and gave it to its four companions, so that by means of that enlivened ultimate support they might become strong, effective for use, and able to endure in their functions. And that ultimate support became for them a continuing vitality.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS toward preservation and endurance by the transfer of ultimate strength to the injured powers.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Stripped off garment and power” is rendered as removal of external investment and operative strength; “remaining life” is taken as continuing vitality sustaining the other functions.

spiritual_reading.overall_coherence: Coherent as a single spiritual sequence: a primary good engages evil, invests itself with an exterior force of love, then—when that outward force is weakened—surrounds itself with a complete set of supportive operative forms. The conflict wounds the operative forms and allows hostile influence to mingle with them, yet an ultimate plane remains unmixed and therefore able to sustain the rest by communicating its steadiness. The main stumble is the damaged syntax in ¶4 and the uncertain term in ¶2, but the spiritual action remains continuous.

findings.diagnosis: Coherent correspondential substrate: combat is taught by function (garment = operative investment; fire = energetic force that withers/consumes), not by jurisdiction. Only a minor lexical uncertainty (“tumescence”) produces interpretive wobble but no narrative break.
findings.evidence: Text: “he clothed the darkness with the garment of living fire. With that garment he withered the tumescence (?) of the enemy; he brought down its foolery and its vanity.” The spiritual reading notes only “The word rendered as ‘tumescence’ is uncertain,” yet the action remains continuous: investing → withering → bringing down vanity. This is classic functional teaching: the ‘garment’ works as an efficacious mode that dries up/suppresses what is inflated.

findings.diagnosis: Coherent correspondential teaching with an internal explanatory aside (“why has he given the four?”). The passage remains functional: additional ‘garments’ are helpers that prevent penetration/poisoning. No administrative overlay (no named rulers, stations, or jurisdiction lists).
findings.evidence: Text: “he added to it another four garments… so that they would be helpers… so that the enemy might come not within the living fire, and penetrate it; and poison and the enmity cut it off.” The spiritual reading admits it “forced into a consistent series of functions,” but that is normal correspondential pressure: the text itself gives the functional rationale (helpers; prevent penetration; prevent poisoning/severing). The narrative does not stumble; it motivates the fourfold addition by the weakening of fire.

findings.diagnosis: Genuine difficulty from damaged/garbled transmission (fractured syntax and likely copyist corruption), not an insertion. The voice remains correspondential (mixing/penetration/wounding are functional processes), but the paragraph contains a broken clause-seam around “necessity… companions… brothers,” producing the reading’s only real stumble.
findings.evidence: Text shows clear disruption: “yet still, [it constrained] all the powers of da[rk]ness because of it [were constrained] It [was also a] necessity [for the five to be companions; it was a] brothers, to cause them to receive a blow and a woun[d to]o.” The spiritual reading explicitly flags: “The paragraph’s syntax is fractured in the source,” and has to smooth “companions/brothers” into an abstract notion of cooperation. But the surrounding logic is consistent: wounding → constraining darkness → mixing “except [the air]” → non-penetration. That consistency argues against an administrative insertion and for textual damage.

findings.diagnosis: Coherent correspondential closure: the unmixed element (air) functions as a sustaining reserve that transfers ‘garment and power’ to strengthen the wounded four. No shift into administrative governance; the spiritual sequence resolves naturally.
findings.evidence: Text: “the air… stripped off garment and power. It gave it to its four brothers… so that by that garment of the living air they would become strong… And it became for them a remaining life.” The spiritual reading tracks this without narrative strain: “transfer… so that… endure… continuing vitality.” The logic is functional/organic (support, endurance, remaining life), not jurisdictional.

textual_criticism.summary: No administrative overlay or seam-expansion is detectable in this chapter. The substrate is predominantly correspondential and narratively continuous (¶2–¶5). The only significant ‘stumble’ noted by the spiritual reading is a genuine difficulty in ¶4 caused by fractured syntax/likely textual corruption, plus a minor lexical uncertainty in ¶2. Recommendations: excise 0; annotate 0; none 4.

changes_summary: No changes made. All findings (1–4) recommended none; there were no excision or annotate recommendations to apply.
